title: REQ · buildSpriteSheet lays equal-size frames into one horizontal sheet with size and frame metadata
summary: Pure buildSpriteSheet concatenates frames left to right and reports width, height, frame size and count
description: Context: no buildSpriteSheet exists under game/. Desired behaviour: buildSpriteSheet(frames) takes RGBA frames {width,height,data} of identical size and returns {width, height, frameWidth, frameHeight, frameCount, data} with frames placed left to right. Expected result: width = frameWidth*frameCount, height = frameHeight, pixels copied unchanged so palette colours are preserved. Empty input or mismatched frame sizes throw. Why: sprite sheets feed the PNG script and manifest in SG-1.3.
acceptance_criteria: Given 4 frames of 32x48, when buildSpriteSheet runs, then width is 128, height is 48, frameWidth is 32, frameHeight is 48 and frameCount is 4
Given frames with distinct pixels, when the sheet is read, then frame i occupies columns i*frameWidth to (i+1)*frameWidth-1 with unchanged pixel values
Given frames of different sizes or an empty list, when buildSpriteSheet runs, then it throws
Given sheets built from gridToRgba frames, when every sheet pixel is read, then its colour is in the shared palette
technical_constraints: Pure function; input frames are not mutated
